description: This file defines types, enums, structures, and function prototypes for the auto-fitter component of the FreeType font rendering library, focusing on script, style, coverage, and hinting data structures and related utilities.

classes.name: AF_WidthRec
classes.description: Structure representing original, current, and fitted widths in font units.

classes.name: AF_Angle
classes.description: Type representing angles used in auto-fitter calculations.

classes.name: AF_ScalerRec
classes.description: Represents the target device scaler for auto-hinting.

classes.name: AF_StyleMetricsRec
classes.description: Main structure for style-specific metrics, including style class, scaler, and global properties.

classes.name: AF_WritingSystemClassRec
classes.description: Class structure for writing system-specific functions and properties.

classes.name: AF_Script_UniRangeRec
classes.description: Represents a range of Unicode code points for scripts.

classes.name: AF_ScriptClassRec
classes.description: Contains script-specific Unicode ranges and standard characters.

classes.name: AF_StyleClassRec
classes.description: Defines style class properties including style, writing system, script, coverage, etc.

methods.name: af_sort_and_quantize_widths
methods.description: Sorts widths and applies quantization based on a threshold.
